== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Quickriver is an [[Archlord]]-class weapon wielded by [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]. The weapon is composed of [[liquid steel]] and possesses the ability to change its shape, functioning as a whip that can stiffen into various forms such as a saber or a short, wide sword. During combat, [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] can manipulate the weapon's reach and form by channeling her [[madra]] into it. The weapon has been used to deflect projectiles, strike opponents in midair, and inflict various injuries, including piercing a chest or delivering shallow cuts. It has also been shown to clash with other blades in combat.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Quickriver is an [[Archlord weapon]] utilized by [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]. This versatile tool functions as a whip of [[liquid steel]] that possesses the ability to stiffen into a saber or be used as a liquid metal blade. During an encounter with Ruby, [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] slashed the weapon. Following this action, Quickriver became covered in orange flame.}}
